cases.note: sed follows an option error with its usage, and prints only its usage when no script is given, exit 1; the page is mirage's own. Run on every backend so a wrapper cannot grow its own spelling again.

expect.stdout:
sed: option '--s' is ambiguous; possibilities: '--silent' '--sandbox' '--separate'
Usage: sed [OPTION]... {script-only-if-no-other-script} [input-file]...
expect.stderr:
Usage: sed [OPTION]... {script-only-if-no-other-script} [input-file]...

Flags:
  -i, --in-place <SUFFIX>             rewrite each file; -iSUFFIX keeps a backup
  -e, --expression <SCRIPT>           one piece of the script, joined in order
  -f, --file <FILE>                   read a piece of the script from FILE
  --follow-symlinks                   with -i, rewrite what a link points to
  -n, --quiet, --silent               print only what the script prints
  --debug                             show the program and trace each command
  -E, -r, --regexp-extended           read regular expressions as ERE
  -l, --line-length <N>               wrap l output at N chars; 0 never wraps
  --posix                             refuse what POSIX sed does not have
  --sandbox                           refuse running programs and opening files
  -s, --separate                      number lines and match $ per file
  -u, --unbuffered                    read only as far as each line needs
  -z, --null-data, --zero-terminated  lines end at NUL, not newline

  --help                              Show this help and exit
